detaileddescription.para: Unit tests for GeoReplicationManager (v1.7.0). Covers all acceptance criteria: AC-1 Per-request consistency level AC-2 Consistency levels: STRONG, BOUNDED_STALENESS, SESSION, EVENTUAL AC-3 Automatic routing based on consistency requirements AC-4 Session tokens for read-your-writes guarantee AC-5 STRONG: Linearizable, up-to-date reads AC-6 BOUNDED_STALENESS: Stale by at most N seconds/versions AC-7 SESSION: Read-your-writes within session AC-8 EVENTUAL: No guarantee, best performance
